_note: openid-connect rejects in the access phase. The upstream is never contacted, so nothing appears in your backend logs. EXECUTED: returns 401. Most caller-side failure causes (no header, no Bearer prefix, non-JWT garbage, bad signature, alg=none, expired, wrong issuer) return an indistinguishable 401 — but a MISSING aud claim returns 403, see missing-audience-403.json.
_headers_present: WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="apisix" — observed; note it names the underlying runtime, and `realm` is a settable plugin field
_not_this: A 302/303/307 with a Location pointing at your Okta domain means unauth_action is still 'auth'. That is a misconfiguration, not an alternative style — API clients cannot follow it usefully.
